'''Nine Lives''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
While you have this card, you cannot be [[devoured]] unless you choose to allow it.

Discard this card if the [[Ancient One]] awakens.
